searchText: Will the Ethereum abbreviation (ETH) be different in the future? Will it change? no. there's only one Ethereum Okay 👍🏻 just wondering. I’m nervous the mining community will try to fork before the bomb and keep “ETH 1.0” someone told me they aren’t capable of communicating as a whole in order to be able to organize something like that - not to mention the talent they’d need to hire Miners decision on keeping or not mining legacy PoW chain doesn't matter for the Merge. Once the first PoS block with execution payload is finalized signifying that transition to PoS has happened PoW chain will have no matter to the canonical Ethereum whatever is happening there.
